caption: The drawing shows an object composed of multiple large feathers, arranged in a fanned-out semicircular pattern. The feathers are primarily brown with darker streaks and lighter, reddish, and golden highlights, displaying natural variegation and striping along their lengths. The base of the feathers is gathered and set into a black, triangular section that serves as a support. Below this section, there is a short, cylindrical handle with a textured appearance, resembling woven or wrapped material in shades of light brown and beige. The background is plain and light-colored, providing contrast to the detailed and richly colored main object. The artist's signature, "Edna Rex," appears in small writing near the bottom right corner.
title: Fan
